export_colmap_to_visualsfm: run the script to export a COLMAP database to VisualSfM format with keypoints and matches
export_binary_sift_files: run the script with binary feature files to export COLMAP keypoints as binary SIFT format
export_text_sift_files: run the script with text feature files to export COLMAP keypoints as plain text SIFT format
filter_matches_by_threshold: run the script with a minimum match threshold to filter two-view geometry matches
decode_pair_id: use the pair_id_to_image_ids function to decode a COLMAP pair ID into two image IDs
